axioms.name: MathLib_exp
axioms.boundary: Opaque model of PRBMath SD59x18.exp pending a Verity fixed-point exp primitive.
axioms.justification: The Reserve auction price-band case needs the function symbol to mirror upstream control flow; proofs consume only the separately listed algebraic property.

axioms.name: MathLib_exp_nonpositive_le_D18
axioms.boundary: Algebraic property of the PRBMath fixed-point exp boundary.
axioms.justification: For non-positive inputs, exp(x) is at most exp(0), represented as D18 in the fixed-point scale.

axioms.name: MathLib_ln

axioms.justification: The value is used only to compute the decay rate inside the translated function and is treated as opaque by the benchmark proofs.

axioms.name: insert_run_of_success
axioms.boundary: Successful modeled insert equals the concrete insertPost list-state record.
axioms.justification: Nested require, walk, and addPanic bind matching is a computational characterization of the modeled body, not an IMTOrder claim.

axioms.name: insert_walk_brackets
axioms.boundary: Pre-state fact: insertLow is an occupied predecessor whose old hop brackets the inserted value.
axioms.justification: Matches IndexedMerkleTree.sol lines 84-93. Uniqueness of the fuelled walk against the successor chain is combinatorial list surgery.

axioms.name: insert_spliced_chain
axioms.boundary: The unique successor list after insert is the old covering chain with the new index spliced after insertLow.
axioms.justification: Constructing the concrete List witness from takeWhile/dropWhile against isIndexChain is combinatorial list surgery over flattened maps.

axioms.name: insert_remaining_fields
axioms.boundary: After sentinel and covering-chain are established, the leftover six IMTOrder fields hold on insertPost.
axioms.justification: Hop-wise increase, unique tail, domains, nonzero leaves, valueToIndex agreement, and the absence bracket still need list induction after the splice.
